modules.description: Single-module PRESENT-80 lightweight block cipher with serial load/unload, iterative one-round-per-clock encryption, inline S-box, pLayer, key schedule, FSM, and counters.
modules.name: present80

ports.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in while high
ports.name: load_en

ports.description: Serial data input, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
ports.name: din

ports.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted
ports.name: shift_out_en

ports.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
ports.name: done

rationale: The spec explicitly mandates a single flat Verilog module with all logic inlined (S-box LUT, pLayer permutation, key schedule rotation/substitution/counter-XOR, 3-state FSM: LOAD/ENCRYPT/UNLOAD, bit counters, and round counter). No sub-modules are permitted, so the hierarchy contains exactly one entry with depends_on=[].
